query: I'm a little leery of these cleansers, since every label on the shelf swears it fixes something different, like trail signs all pointing opposite ways. So here's what I want: a facial cleanser, and the skin benefit has to be acne care (I'll check the label myself, don't worry). Nothing over 435 cts, y'all (yes, every penny counts for me, and student loans ain't gonna pay themselves). Something you actually have on hand, not just on a website somewhere. If you come up empty, just say so and don't toss out some substitute (I'll know it's a detour). I'm a student, so I can only afford one bottle this semester (no second tries). Total, you can send me 3 messages and no more than that. Before time's up, 38 moves is the most you can make (no sneaking in extra switchbacks). My roommate says I should just grab whatever's popular, but I'd rather the one I pick suit what my face is actually going through.

rules: Only items actually on hand in the store.
If nothing fits, say so; no substitutes.
Send no more than 3 messages to the shopper.
Use no more than 38 moves, no extra switchbacks.
Buy only one bottle; no second purchases.
wishes: Pick the cleanser that suits my skin's needs, not the popular one.

ask.label: skin type
ask.hint: suit what my face is actually going through
